compressor_1.basis: Trapezoid corner points decoded verbatim: left edge 230 units tall, right edge 115 units tall, width 192 units, common centreline at y = 461; ports at the edge midpoints on the centreline.

expander_1.name: Expander
expander_1.basis: Traced by symmetry with compressor_1 (same polygon class, reversed taper). The stored instance in the expander source file has a portrait bounding box (307,634)-(383,748), indicating a 90-degree rotated stored orientation; the library supplies the horizontal flowsheet form, with rotation noted. Port extraction for this file was partial (two port anchors at (364,641) and (324,726) in the stored orientation).

heat_exchanger_1.name: Heat exchanger
heat_exchanger_1.basis: Circle decoded from the extracted outline ring (bounding box (173,119)-(285,231), centre (229,175), radius 56); four ports decoded verbatim. The two internal lines (line shape records) are drawn as the diameter diagonals of the circle.

flash_1.name: Flash drum (vertical vessel)
flash_1.basis: Body bounding frame (250,250)-(366,518) and all eight port anchors decoded verbatim (six left-side ports, top centre port, right port at the liquid level). Head form: 2:1 elliptical caps (depth 29 units on a 116-unit diameter); the cap outline piece decoded from the file is a shallow ellipse segment (30 by 11 units in its local frame). Liquid level line at the right-port elevation y = 461.

vessel_1.name: Horizontal vessel (reflux drum)
vessel_1.basis: Structural trace. The file contains 12 port instances and two instances of an end-cap outline piece (30 by 11 units in local frame, cap depth 0.37 of diameter); the body is drawn as a horizontal drum of diameter 60 units with half-ellipse caps of depth 22 units and a liquid level line. Body proportions follow the decoded cap ratio; absolute body length is a library convention (3 diameters overall).

scds_1.name: Distillation column
scds_1.basis: Body rectangle (530,200)-(590,520) and top cap arc decoded verbatim (arc points (530,235),(530,227),(543,220),(559,220),(575,220),(588,227),(588,235): chord at y = 235, apex at y = 220, depth 15 on a 60 width); bottom cap mirrored. Five tray lines represent the repeated tray group instances in the file (group shape records). The file contains 20 port instances (stage ports); principal ports listed are the overhead and bottoms anchors on the body axis.

kinetic_1.name: Stirred reactor
kinetic_1.basis: Body frame (557,461)-(711,767), top head arc points and bottom port (634,767) decoded verbatim; the arc is drawn through the seven decoded points. Agitator shaft, impeller, and drive block: forms from the shape inventory (line, rectangle, and chord shape records). One decoded line segment ((691,460)-(726,422)) could not be interpreted and is not drawn.
